name: podbenchmark
description: Compare print-on-demand supplier prices from the terminal: product cost, shipping and delivered totals for Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, CustomCat, Fourthwall and Inkthreadable. Built for sellers, developers and AI agents.

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --minify --outfile dist/podbenchmark.mjs --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && chmod +x dist/podbenchmark.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build
